learning_outcomes.text: Solves differential equations using Laplace transforms.
Derives mathematical models of various physical systems.
Creates the transfer function and block diagram of a physical system.
Interprets the stability of a control system using stability criteria.
Derives the equations of motion for a physical system.

syllabus_topics: Transfer Functions, Solution of Linear Differential Equations with Laplace Transform
Derivation of Mathematical Models of Various Physical Systems
Derivation of Mathematical Models of Various Physical Systems
assessment_rules: The midterm exam accounts for 40% of the grade, and the final exam accounts for 60%. Midterm and final exam dates are determined by the University Senate and specified in the academic calendar.
